newsitem.title: INDIA: India's HLL, Brooke Bond merge.
newsitem.headline: India's HLL, Brooke Bond merge.

text.p: Hindustan Lever Ltd and Brooke Bond Lipton India Ltd, Unilever Plc's leading Indian subsidiaries, on Friday said the two firms had merged with effect from January 1, 1996.
Shareholders of both firms had approved the merger last June.
At a board meeting on Friday, the directors also approved the financial results of the merged company, also called Hindustan Lever, for the year ending December 31, 1996.

Net profit and sales of the combined firm totalled 4.14 billion rupees and 66.00 billion, respectively. In 1995, profits and sales of Hindustan Lever alone were 2.39 billion rupees and 33.67 billion, respectively.

Effective January 1, 1996, Hindustan Lever's bulk chemicals and fertilisers businesses were transfered to Hind Lever Chemicals Ltd and in turn the detergents business of Hind Lever Chemicals was transfered to Hindustan Lever.
Consequently, the figures for 1996 are not comparable to those of the previous year, Hindustan Lever said in a statement.
Prior to the merger, Hindustan Lever was India's leading producer of soaps and detergents. Brooke Bond Lipton was the leading player in packaged tea and processed foods.
